Band.title: Let's take a Qadam toward trust.

Creed.title: A community that builds, not just consumes.
Creed.lede: Central Asia can stay a user of other people's solutions — or grow its own engineers. We chose the second and do it in the open: the methodology, infrastructure, and brand belong to the community, not to one person or company.
Creed.principle1Body: We don't promote what doesn't exist or hasn't been proven in practice.
Creed.principle2Body: Speakers talk about what they did themselves. A real case beats a polished framework.
Creed.principle3Body: We discuss failures openly. An honest postmortem teaches more than a success story.
Creed.principle4Body: Partners invest in people. We are not an advertising platform.
Creed.quote: In the end, AI Qadam isn't about artificial intelligence. It's about people.
Creed.quoteMeta: Qadam means "a step forward" in Turkic languages

Metrics.metric2Label: people in the room every time

Doors.title: Three doors. All open.
Doors.lede: After the first meetup, 86% of attendees chose an active role instead of "just showing up." From there it's a question of how much time you're ready to invest.
Doors.door1Body: Register for the next event and your country's chat. Free, no selection process, no "leave your application."
Doors.door2Body: CFP for meetup #3 in September is open. We need your own case — what you did, what broke, what worked.
Doors.door3Body: Open infrastructure for the region: Qadam Flow, the design system, the portal. Contributor → committer → maintainer, by contribution, not by title.

Events.title: Depth, not "AI for beginners."
Events.lede: Seven talks across two meetups: multi-agent systems in KYC/AML, offensive security, the path from prototype to production, governance for agent swarms. Eight people volunteered to speak.
Events.talk1Desc: A multi-agent architecture automating over 90% of KYC / AML.
Events.talk2Desc: Offensive security in practice. AppSec engineer.
Events.talk3Desc: Architecture, mistakes, metrics. CEO and founder.
Events.talk4Desc: How to validate an idea for $5. Engineering Manager.
Events.sourceNote: Meetup #2: Pavel Popov — from chatbot to agent orchestra · Alex Zhurayev — low-code AI for operational resilience · Konstantin Gus — governance for agent swarms.

MapSection.title: A federation, not a franchise.
MapSection.lede: Everything that can be standardized — brand, methodology, formats, infrastructure — comes from the center. Everything local — language, partners, context — stays with the local team.
MapSection.svgAriaLabel: Map of AI Qadam's presence: Tashkent and Almaty active, Dushanbe and Bishkek planned
MapSection.chapter1Desc: Home base. This is where Global lives.
MapSection.chapter2Desc: Its own meetup in Almaty on June 20 — the same day as Tashkent.
MapSection.chapter4Desc: After that — the whole Turkic world.
MapSection.ctaLaunchChapter: Launch a chapter in your city

Streams.title: Four streams, one core.
Streams.lede: We show status honestly: live, in progress, or planned. Nothing here is sold as finished until it actually is.
Streams.stream1Desc: Meetups, Fail Stories, hackathons — the engine of the whole ecosystem.
Streams.stream2Desc: The community's social projects. The first is Suhbat, anonymous support with AI involved.
Streams.stream3Desc: Honest assessment of AI skills and programs built by practitioners.
Streams.stream4Desc: Support for startups: engineering, grants, access to investors.
Streams.foundationBody: Not a fifth stream, but the foundation under the other four: open source code the community owns and runs itself. MIT / Apache-2.0, no paid gates on SSO or audit logs.

Partners.title: Partners invest in the community, not buy an audience.
Partners.partner1Desc: A Tashkent tech hub: offices, coworking, event spaces.
Partners.partner2Desc: Uzbekistan's cloud provider, 99.999% SLA. Startup of the Year 2025.
Partners.disclaimer: We don't sell access to the audience, trade participant data, or dress up sales pitches as expert talks. What's in and out of bounds is spelled out in the partner deck.

Team.title: Practitioners, not community managers.
Team.lede: The brand belongs to the community, not to a founder. Decisions are made by the Global Board: consensus instead of voting, country leads hold veto on local matters.
Team.team1Desc: CTO at BEELAB (Beepul, VEON). 12 years in engineering, 6+ as CTO.
Team.team2Desc: Senior ML Engineer at Verigram, Head of Speech Recognition at CyberNet AI.
Team.team3Desc: Head of Software Development at ABiTech. SAP Banking, Temenos T24.
Team.team4Desc: Ipoteka Bank (OTP Group). Launched EPAM Uzbekistan from scratch, founder of Agile Uzbekistan.
Team.team5Desc: Kanban / Agile practitioner and coach, Senior PM at Ipoteka Bank.
